summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react-native-web preinstall executes obfuscated Bun-compiled payload under an alternate runtime
details: The package advertises itself as a deprecated jest preset redirect: the declared main jest-preset.js is a two-line stub that throws Error('Use @ornikar/jest-config-react-native/web instead'). Despite having no functional library surface, package.json declares preinstall: node setup.mjs. setup.mjs is heavily string-array-obfuscated (identifiers like _0x488df8, _0x19328d.QkQej="--version", _0x5f1571.SBBJg="bun") and at install time either (a) invokes any bun already on PATH to run a shipped 727KB math_init.js, or (b) downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/*.zip into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and execFileSync's it against math_init.js. math_init.js is a compiled Bun bundle (header // @bun @bun-cjs) with a large obfuscated string/number constant array and a rotate-dispatcher (WV8StW), unrelated to any jest configuration. A jest preset redirect has no legitimate need to fetch and execute a foreign runtime against an opaque compiled payload at install; the entire behavioral surface of this release is the preinstall dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
